Legend

Ally with the Marids, an ancient race of Djinns to obliterate their counterparts, the fearsome Efreets, and gain eternal trust from those powerful creatures.

Location

Ashta'daramai (Blue Djinn Fortress)

Dangers

Green Djinns, Efreets, Dragon, Orc Warlords, Orc Leaders, Gargoyles, Orc Berserkers, Stone Golems, Stalkers, Orc Warriors, and a Wyvern in the path of the secret entrance of green djinn fortress. Also minor creatures like Cobras, Lions and Hyaenas in the path.

Reward

3 Small Sapphires, Gemmed Lamp, the ability to trade with Nah'Bob and Haroun, possibility to hunt Efreet and Green Djinns in Ankrahmun and Yalahar and possibility to start a green djinn hunting task.

Spoiler • edit


Note: Before starting The Djinn War quest, consider doing the quest To Appease the Mighty. Since this quest can only be completed before starting The Djinn War and rewards 20 Platinum Coins.

Introduction

There are two warring Djinn factions, the Blue Djinns & Marids up against the Green Djinns & Efreets. As part of the war both engage in conflict while also trading strong Equipment at competitive prices. However, they are selective in their dealings, preferring to trade only with those they trust. To gain their trust, you must pledge allegiance to either the Blue or Green Djinn faction (each offering distinct items). Once accepted, you can engage in buying and selling equipment with them.

Required Equipment

  • Cheese - Used to interact with Rata'mari in the Green Djinn Fortress.
  • Cookbook - Needed for a mission with Bo'ques.

Method

Note: You can only align with one of the Djinn factions (Blue or Green). If you prefer to side with the Efreet (Green), refer to the Efreet Faction Quest Guide.

  • In Ankrahmun, locate Melchior around here (33192, 32820, 7) wandering the streets. Speak with him to learn about Djinn customs and the greeting word "DJANNI'HAH". This word allows entry into either Djinn Fortress.
  • To reach the Blue Djinn Fortress, take the ramp west of the Giant Spider hill (here (33120, 32578, 7)) north of Ankrahmun.
  • Navigate northwest until you encounter the Level 30 Door of Expertise.
  • Inside the fortress, greet Umar with "DJANNI'HAH" and inform him you seek passage.
  • Note: After initial contact, "Hi" suffices for subsequent interactions.

Marid Mission 1

  • After listening to him, proceed to the upper floor and speak with Bo'ques. Ask him for a Mission; and he will ask you to retrieve a Cookbook from Maryza in Kazordoon.
  • Go to Kazordoon (if you do not have the cookbook already), and talk to Maryza in the Tavern (near the depot) by saying Hi Maryza. The cookbook will cost you 150gp. Also note that she will only sell one copy per player.
  • Return to Bo'ques, talk to him, and give him the Cookbook. He will reward you with 3 Small Sapphires and tell you that Fa'hradin might have some work for you.

Marid Mission 2

  • Talk to Fa'hradin he is on the balcony on the same floor as Bo'ques here (33106, 32541, 5), and ask for a Mission. He will tell you to get a report from a spy they have in the Green Djinn fortress, and he will give you the password PIEDPIPER.

Note: This is the first part; you must invade the opposing Djinn Tower. You cannot enter the back way of the Green Djinn Tower until you have acquired this mission.

  • You will need to go to the secret entrance (33033, 32620, 6) to the Green Djinn fortress. Besure to bring the Cheese with you.
  • First, go up the ramp west of the Oasis here (33101, 32657, 7).
  • Instead of going west to the front door of the Green Djinn fortress, follow the path north (33060, 32594, 6), around to the back of the fortress. You will go up and down a few ramps and face some Lions, Hyaenas, Cobras, Scorpions, and a Wyvern.
  • When you reach the back door, go inside.
  • After killing the Hyaenas and the Green Djinn, go down the steps.
  • Here you will face 3 Green Djinns. Kill them all and talk to the rat NPC Rata'mari. Say the password PIEDPIPER instead of saying Hi. Then ask him for the Spy Report, then say Yes to give him the Cheese.
  • Take the Spy Report back to Fa'hradin in the Blue Djinn fortress. When you give him the spy report, he will tell you to go speak with Gabel upstairs.

Marid Mission 3

  • Go upstairs and talk to Gabel here (33102, 32520, 1). Ask him for a Mission, and he will tell you that he needs you to retrieve a Gemmed Lamp from the Orc King deep in Ulderek's Rock.
  • Go to Ulderek's Rock[128.106-124.28-7] (32874, 31772, 7) The Orc Fortress, and speak with the Orc King found here (32982, 31736, 9). To enter the chamber a min. level 40 is required. Be careful because if you have never spoken to The Orc King, he will summon some Orc Warlords, Orc Leaders, Orc Berserkers and possibly other things. Ask him for the lamp , and when asked Who do you want to trap in this cursed lamp? reply by saying Malor.

NOTE: The safest way to do this is to throw a Poison Bomb rune under the Orc King, then greet him twice, grab the lamp and run away.

  • Take the lamp into the Green Djinn fortress and stealthily make your way to Malor's personal bedchamber. Re-enter through the secret passage to reach the top floor, where you'll encounter an increasing number of Green Djinns, Efreets, and Gargoyles. It's advisable to bring Dwarven Rings and enlist strong shooters and blockers for assistance. Previously, stairhopping was feasible before the spring patch, but this method is no longer viable, making it preferable to proceed with capable allies. Knights may use exori mas, paladins exevo mas san, and mages can rely on runes for sufficient damage. Always wear a dwarven ring and consider casting mana shield for added protection.
  • When you reach Malor's bedchamber, "use" the lamp THAT'S ON THE COUNTER, next to his bed.
  • Stand in front of the lamp (bed) and click use on your lamp once (to be sure, check your Quest log, the third mission, it should say "You successfully changed...").
  • Return to Gabel in the Blue Djinn fortress and tell him you completed the Mission. You will now be able to trade with Haroun and Nah'Bob. It is now also possible to begin a Green Djinn - Hunting Task by mentioning task to Gabel.

Transcripts

Melchior

Player: Hi
Melchior: Greetings, player. I do not see your face, but I can read a thousand things in your voice!
Player: Word of Greeting
Melchior: The djinns have an ancient code of honour. This code includes a special concept of hospitality. Anybody who utters the word of greeting must not be attacked even if he is an enemy. Well, at least that is what the code says. ...
Melchior: I have found out, though, that this does not work at all times. There is no point to say the word of greeting to an enraged djinn. ...
Melchior: I can tell you the word of greeting if you're interested. It is DJANNI'HAH. Remember this word well, stranger. It might save your life one day. ...
Melchior: And keep in mind that you must choose sides in this conflict. You can only follow the Efreet or the Marid - once you have made your choice there is no way back. I know from experience that djinn do not tolerate double-crossing.
Player: Bye
Melchior: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Marid Mission 1

Umar

Player: DJANNI'HAH
Umar: Whoa? You know the word! Amazing, Player! ...
Umar: I should go and tell Fa'hradin. ...
Umar: Well. Why are you here anyway, Player?
Player: Passage
Umar: If you want to enter our fortress you have to become one of us and fight the Efreet. ...
Umar: So, are you willing to do so?
Player: Yes
Umar: Are you sure? You pledge loyalty to king Gabel, who is... you know. And you are willing to never ever set foot on Efreets' territory, unless you want to kill them? Yes?
Player: Yes
Umar: Oh. Ok. Welcome then. You may pass. ...
Umar: And don't forget to kill some Efreets, now and then.
Player: Bye
Umar: <salutes>Aaaa -tention!.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Bo'ques

Player: Hi
Bo'ques: Hey! A human! What are you doing in my kitchen, Player?
Player: Mission
Bo'ques: My collection of recipes is almost complete. There are only but a few that are missing. ...
Bo'ques: Hmmm... now that we talk about it. There is something you could help me with. Are you interested?
Player: Yes
Bo'ques: Fine! Even though I know so many recipes, I'm looking for the description of some dwarven meals. ...
Bo'ques: So, if you could bring me a cookbook of the dwarven kitchen I will reward you well.
Player: Cookbook
Bo'ques: Do you have the cookbook of the dwarven kitchen with you? Can I have it?
Player: Yes
Bo'ques: The book! You have it! Let me see! <browses the book> ...
Bo'ques: Dragon Egg Omelette, Dwarven beer sauce... it's all there. This is great! Here is your well-deserved reward. ...
Bo'ques: Incidentally, I have talked to Fa'hradin about you during dinner. I think he might have some work for you. Why don't you talk to him about it?
Player: Bye
Bo'ques: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Marid Mission 2

Fa'hradin, First visit

Player: Hi
Fa'hradin: Aaaah... what have we here. A human - interesting. And such an ugly specimen, too... All right, human player. How can I help you?
Player: Mission
Fa'hradin: I have heard some good things about you from Bo'ques. But I don't know. ...
Fa'hradin: Well, all right. I do have a job for you. ...
Fa'hradin: In order to stay informed about our enemy's doings, we have managed to plant a spy in Mal'ouquah. ...
Fa'hradin: He has kept the Efreet and Malor under surveillance for quite some time. ...
Fa'hradin: But unfortunately, I have lost contact with him months ago. ...
Fa'hradin: I do not fear for his safety because his cover is foolproof, but I cannot contact him either. This is where you come in. ...
Fa'hradin: I need you to infiltrate Mal'ouqhah, contact our man there and get his latest spyreport. The password is PIEDPIPER. Remember it well! ...
Fa'hradin: I do not have to add that this is a dangerous mission, do I? If you are discovered expect to be attacked! So goodluck, human!
Fa'hradin: Farewell, human.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Rata'mari

Player: PIEDPIPER
Rata'mari: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, Player... Being a rat has kind of grown on me.
Player: Spy Report
Rata'mari: You have come for the report? Great! I have been working hard on it during the last months. And nobody came to pick it up. I thought everybody had forgotten about me! ...
Rata'mari: Do you have any idea how difficult it is to hold a pen when you have claws instead of hands? ...
Rata'mari: But - you know - now I have worked so hard on this report I somehow don't want to part with it. Atleast not without some decent payment. ...
Rata'mari: All right - listen - I know Fa'hradin would not approve of this, but I can't help it. I need some cheese! I need it now! ...
Rata'mari: And I will not give the report to you until you get me some! Meep!
Player: Spy Report
Rata'mari: Ok, have you brought me the cheese, I've asked for?
Player: Yes
Rata'mari: Meep! Meep! Great! Here is the spyreport for you!
Rata'mari: Meep!

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Fa'hradin, Second visit

Player: Hi
Fa'hradin: Aaaah... what have we here. A human - interesting. And such an ugly specimen, too... All right, human player. How can I help you?
Player: Mission
Fa'hradin: Did you already retrieve the spyreport?
Player: Yes
Fa'hradin: You really have made it? You have the report? How come you did not get slaughtered? I must say I'm impressed. Your race will never cease to surprise me. ...
Fa'hradin: Well, let's see. ...
Fa'hradin: I think I need to talk to Gabel about this. I am sure he will know what to do. Perhaps you should have aword with him, too.
Player: Bye
Fa'hradin: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Marid Mission 3

Gabel

Player: Hi
Gabel: Welcome, human Player, to our humble abode.
Player: Mission
Gabel: Sooo. Fa'hradin has told me about your extraordinary exploit, and I must say I am impressed. ...
Gabel: Your fragile human form belies your courage and your fighting spirit. ...
Gabel: I hardly dare to ask you because you have already done so much for us, but there is a task to be done, and I cannot think of anybody else who would be better suited to fulfill it than you. ...
Gabel: Think carefully, human, for this mission will bring you into real danger. Are you prepared to do us that final favour?
Player: Yes
Gabel: All right. Listen! Thanks to Rata'mari's report we now know what Malor is up to: he wants to do to me what I have done to him - he wants to imprison me in Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
Gabel: Of course, that won't happen. Now, we know his plans. ...
Gabel: But I am aiming at something different. We have learnt one important thing: At this point of time, Malor does not have the lamp yet, which means it is still where he left it. We need that lamp! If we get it back we can imprison him again! ...
Gabel: From all we know the lamp is still in the Orc King's possession! Therefore I want to ask you to enter thewell guarded halls over at Ulderek's Rock and find the lamp. ...
Gabel: Once you have acquired the lamp you must enter Mal'ouquah again. Sneak into Malor's personal chambersand exchange his sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp! ...
Gabel: If you succeed, the war could be over one night later! I and all djinn will be in your debt forever! May Daraman watch over you!
Player: Bye
Gabel: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

The Orc King

Player: Hi
(He will spawn up lots of monsters around himself) The Orc King: Arrrrgh! A dirty paleskin! To me my children! Kill them my guards!

The Djinn War - Marid Faction


Player: Hi
The Orc King: Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
Player: Lamp
The Orc King: I can sense your evil intentions to imprison a djinn! You are longing for the lamp, which I still possess. ...
The Orc King: Who do you want to trap in this cursed lamp?
Player: Malor
The Orc King: I was waiting for this day! Take the lamp and let Malor feel my wrath!
Player: Bye
The Orc King: We will meet again.

The Djinn War - Marid Faction

Gabel

Player: Hi
Gabel: Welcome, human Player, to our humble abode.
Player: Mission
Gabel: Have you found Fa'hradin's lamp and placed it in Malor's personal chambers?
Player: Yes
Gabel: Daraman shall bless you and all humans! You have done us all a huge service! Soon, this awful war will be over! ...
Gabel: Know, that from now on you are considered one of us and are welcome to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob whenever you want to!
Player: Bye
Gabel: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
